project_name.justification: The article title is 'CanAlaska Completes Acquisition of Mel Nickel Deposit in Thompson Nickel Belt, Manitoba' and the project is also referred to as the 'Mel Project' in the body of the text.

company_name.justification: The acquiring company is identified in the first paragraph: 'CanAlaska Uranium Ltd. (TSXV: CVV) (OTCQX: CVVUF) (FSE: DH7N) ("CanAlaska or the "Company") is pleased to announce that it has now completed the acquisition of the Mel nickel deposit...'

ceo_buyer.justification: The CEO of the acquiring company, CanAlaska, is identified in the text: 'On behalf of the Board of Directors "Cory Belyk" Cory Belyk, P.Geo., FGC CEO, Executive Vice President and Director CanAlaska Uranium Ltd.'

interest_acquired_percent.justification: The text states that CanAlaska has 'completed the acquisition of the Mel nickel deposit', which implies a 100% interest.

primary_commodity.justification: The project is explicitly referred to as a nickel deposit in the title and body of the text: 'CanAlaska Completes Acquisition of Mel Nickel Deposit' and 'Completion of this transaction gives CanAlaska and its shareholders a concrete and tangible NI43-101 compliant high-grade sulphide nickel resource...'

verified_article_link.justification: The article is directly about the acquisition of the Mel project by CanAlaska Uranium Ltd. The source link is provided at the bottom of the press release.

currency.justification: The acquiring company's primary listing is on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV), a Canadian exchange, and the stock quote is listed with a '$' symbol, implying Canadian Dollars (CAD). 'Exchange: TSXV'
